  (acceptance "cargo check passes; unit test proves the leaf credential signature key equals ChatIdentity's public key (TEST-007)."))

(meta task-storage

  (acceptance "Condition I test: after Commit merge / Welcome consume, superseded epoch secrets and consumed init keys are absent from disk; state reloads across a simulated restart (TEST-009)."))

(meta task-pins
  (description "Pin store (REQ-011): handle->wire-key pins from verified per-frame signatures only; idkey assertion frame with DS label cbcl-idkey-assert/v1 (REQ-019); cross-signed rekey ceremony cbcl-idkey-rotate/v1 (REQ-011); removal-evidence label cbcl-mls-remove/v1 reserved. Pins persisted durably.")
  (acceptance "Condition A-t: property test asserts no cross-protocol signature collision between the wire envelope, each app DS label, and MLS SignWithLabel domains (TEST-011, TEST-019; OQ-001)."))

(meta task-keypkgs
  (description "KeyPackage lifecycle: build last-resort (short MLS lifetime) + one-time packages carrying the REQ-007 credential and genesis capability; publish via keypub; client-enforced single-use with durable consumed-KeyPackageRef ledger and delete-after-successful-join ordering (REQ-002, REQ-013, REQ-022); validate keypkg/keyget inputs client-side (REQ-015).")
  (acceptance "Tests: init key survives a failed Welcome, is deleted from memory+disk only after successful join; expired last-resort rejected via KeyPackageIn::validate (TEST-002, TEST-013, TEST-022)."))

(meta task-group
  (description "Group lifecycle: create group with genesis GroupContext extension + capability asserted at creation (REQ-016, K-2 guard); deterministic owner election over MLS leaves (REQ-004/REQ-016); adder verification target+pinned-key (REQ-008); full-tree pin-checked app-bound Welcome validation incl. pre-finalize genesis read (REQ-001, REQ-012).")
  (acceptance "Tests: K-2 creation without capability fails before first commit; Welcome with unpinned key for pinned handle hard-rejects; wrong-room/wrong-committer/replacing Welcome rejected; election deterministic across permutations (TEST-001, TEST-003, TEST-004, TEST-008, TEST-012, TEST-016)."))

(meta task-validation
  (description "Inbound membership-change validation (REQ-017 a-e): every leaf-changing object (Add/Update/Remove proposals + committer UpdatePath leaf) checked for handle + pinned key + credential immutability; fail-closed proposal allowlist; genesis immutability; capability advertisement required. Sender-authenticated :from (REQ-018). Decrypt with drop-but-count fork signal (REQ-006). Encrypt outbound (REQ-005).")
  (acceptance "Tests: credential-rebinding self-Update rejected (the R3-07 oracle); forged :from rejected; ReInit/PSK/GCE/external-join rejected; decrypt-failure run surfaces fork signal (TEST-005, TEST-006, TEST-017, TEST-018)."))

(meta task-removal
  (description "Authenticated removal (REQ-014): signed removal-evidence object bound to (room, group_id, epoch, target handle + leaf index + leaf key) under cbcl-mls-remove/v1; minted by subject bye or authorized remover (added_by / creator fallback); carried with every Remove; verified at merge by every validator with exact live-epoch freshness; unsigned hub presence never triggers a Remove.")
  (acceptance "Condition K-1 test: evidence minted at epoch N loses a race to a concurrent Commit, is rejected at N+1, and removal succeeds on retry with fresh evidence; stale evidence cannot remove a re-added member (TEST-014)."))

(meta task-safety
  (description "Safety numbers (REQ-021): identity safety number with the pinned canonical encoding (cbcl-mls-identity-safety/v1 frame, SHA-256, 8x8 lowercase hex) + epoch state hash diagnostic; cross-stack test vector; hark safety-number CLI surface via local API (REQ-024).")
  (acceptance "Byte-exact test vector committed; number stable across pure ratchet Commits, flips on membership change; CLI prints both values (TEST-021, TEST-024)."))

(meta task-wiring
  (description "Session wiring: encryption-mode pin from admission path/operator intent, fail closed on downgrade or unpinnable private mode (REQ-023); on pinned-encrypted join publish KeyPackages, handle keypkg/welcome/deliver frames, route outbound through MLS encrypt and inbound through MLS decrypt before the responder; no plaintext content on the wire (NFR-002).")
  (acceptance "Tests: roomcfg :enc false on pinned channel refuses send; outbound in encrypted channel is a deliver :enc mls frame whose payload openmls decrypts; inbound deliver decrypts then dispatches to responder (TEST-005, TEST-020 n/a hark, TEST-023)."))

(meta task-integration

; =============================================================================
; R5 Behavioural Contracts — wire shape + causal-protocol runtime enforcement
; from cbcl-rs SPEC-002 into the hark daemon's outbound and inbound paths.
; =============================================================================
;
; Background (read once):
;
;   cbcl-rs SPEC-002 defines R5 in two layers:
;     install-time well-formedness — already done in hark via
;     `cbcl_parser::run_pipeline` on (define ...) forms in dialect_cache.rs
;     and local_api.rs `validate_define`.
;
;     runtime behavioural enforcement — NOT yet done in hark. For every
;     simple (non-meta) message that flows through the daemon, the dialect's
;     `(protocol ...)` and `(shape ...)` clauses must be checked against the
;     message before it reaches its destination:
;
;       outbound — between `validate_for_send` and the router write
;       inbound  — in `process_inbound` for InboundClass::Ordinary, before
;                  the message lands on the recv queue
;
;   cbcl-parser exposes `run_pipeline_full(input, &PipelineContext<S>)` which
;   does parse → R1–R5 install + (for simple messages) causal verify (6a) →
;   evaluate → shape check (6b) in one pass. It needs a `DialectRegistry` and
;   a `MessageStore` (cbcl-core ships `ThreadedMessageStore`).
;
